subject: Coord: SOC 2 / Pen-test / DPA walkthrough — slot coordination and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Priya Kapoor <priya@fintechco.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / Pen-test / DPA walkthrough — week of Apr 20

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting procurement due diligence and would like to schedule a combined walkthrough to cover:
- SOC 2 control mapping and report cadence
- Pen-test scope & vendor handoff expectations
- DPA items (data flows and SFTP/evidence transfer)

Goals: align on scope, confirm evidence delivery options, and leave with a mutual action plan (owner + 2 week follow-ups).

Preferred windows from our side:
- Tue Apr 20: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Apr 21: 14:00–16:00 CET (we have folks in London + Bangalore)

I've attached a short questionnaire that lists the initial evidence requests (FintechCo_SOC2_Prelim_Questionnaire.pdf). Could you confirm which of your folks should join (security + engineering + legal as needed)?

Thanks,
Priya Kapoor
Head of GRC, FintechCo
priya@fintechco.com
[Attachment: FintechCo_SOC2_Prelim_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Priya —

Thanks — this is exactly the right scope. Proposed approach: 75 minute session (45 min walkthrough, 15 min Q&A, 15 min action items + owners).

Two slot options that work for our team:
- Tue Apr 20: 09:30–10:45 PT (works for our US security + engineering)
- Wed Apr 21: 15:00–16:15 CET (we can pole in an engineer remotely for the APAC overlap)

Can you confirm which slot you prefer? I'm including a quick attendee matrix (Redwood_Attendee_Matrix.csv) to capture who will be on the call and the single point for evidence delivery.

Bridge: we'll use an ops bridge and SFTP transfer for artifacts — I will share runbook + handoff steps once slot is confirmed.

Link to quick poll (slot sweep): https://cal.poll/redwood-fintechco/slot-sweep

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

vivek@redwood.com

Vivek —

I've signed and initiated the DPA pre-ack via DocuSign here: https://docusign.net/FintechCo-DPA-RDW-4721

Looking forward —
